{{Top|leg}}
'''Ath''' was an entity in [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] mythology that welcomed the [[Death/Legends|dead]] into the afterlife.

It was also an archaic name given to Zabrak [[Gender/Legends|females]].
